ownedPathDisposition.zod: 4.4.3 remains pinned. Actual late array admission reproduced in projectNativeDetail; #107 adds leading checks for all 21 native array caps and the existing 64-key record cap, with zero-child-read regressions. No global Zod remediation claimed.
ownedPathDisposition.mcp: Existing #105 reviewed profile companion and no-provider fixed-Bearer scope apply. No other-release risk acceptance is reused.
ownedPathDisposition.undici: 8.10.2 is imported by the examined DSH HTTP proxy for Agent/Pool/ProxyAgent and global dispatcher management. This bridge uses global fetch; examined Node22.22.3/Node24.19.0 fetch implementations report bundled Undici6.24.1/7.29.0, outside the reported >=8 ranges. EventSource/integrity consumers are not added by this plugin. This source mapping is not a whole-Host exploit assessment.
ownedPathDisposition.fast-uri: 3.1.8 is under Ajv. The plugin URL and same-origin authorization use WHATWG URL rather than fast-uri; no new remote-schema loading or URI authorization consumer is introduced. Schema-normalization behavior in other Host consumers is not certified.
ownedPathDisposition.archivedEvidence: One Zod alert points at a historical Windows evidence lockfile; that lockfile is not an installed dependency of this candidate.

scope: Owned input validation is repaired; upstream Host/library findings remain visible and are not globally closed.
